title: Cached JNIEnv* and raw local references
description: gJavaEnv/gJavaObj/gJavaClass are captured from nativeInit/nativeReInit without NewGlobalRef and reused by all 26 callbacks in later native frames.
port_guidance: Hold ADRenderer (or its replacement) in a NewGlobalRef, cache jclass as global ref, and obtain JNIEnv per call via JavaVM::GetEnv (or pass it down from the current JNI entry).

title: Native pointers carried in Java int
description: JAVAOpenFeintSubmit(..., int CBOFOStatePtr) / JAVAOpenFeintUnlock(..., int) receive &gOFOData[...] and JNIOFOSubmitCB(int)/JNIOFOUnlockCB(int) dereference it as uint8_t*.
port_guidance: Use jlong (or an index into gOFOData) in the port; the Java shell descriptors must change accordingly, or OpenFeint must be stubbed so the callbacks never fire.

title: FileDescriptor -> int fd extraction
description: JNIDatInit reflects FileDescriptor.descriptor (private) and dup()s it.
port_guidance: Use AAssetManager_open + AAsset_openFileDescriptor64 (off64_t start/length) or ParcelFileDescriptor.getFd()/detachFd().

title: AssetFileDescriptor offsets truncated to int
description: getStartOffset()/getLength() are long-to-int'd before JNIDatInit; native stores them in 32-bit globals and fseek()s with long.
port_guidance: Pass int64 (jlong/off64_t) and use fseeko/pread with 64-bit offsets.

title: Split 64-bit time
description: System.nanoTime is returned as two jints (JAVATime low word, JAVATimeHi from a static long) and recombined natively into uint64 microseconds.
port_guidance: Replace with clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC) in native code; keep microsecond uint64 semantics (callers compare r0:r1).

title: Byte[] buffers sized by native code
description: JAVAUnZip/UnJpg/UnPng/LoadFile/LastLoggedInUserID write into arrays whose size is chosen natively; overflow is either swallowed (UnZip) or leaves a pending exception (UnPng/UnJpg/UserID) that native never checks.
port_guidance: Decode natively (zlib/libpng/libjpeg or stb) into caller-sized buffers with explicit length checks; if JNI is kept, add ExceptionCheck.

title: Pixel format contract of JAVAC_UnPng/UnJpg
description: Rows are copied bottom-up into a buffer preceded by an 18-byte TGA header (32 bpp, descriptor 8); pixel bytes come from ARGB_8888 copyPixelsToBuffer (RGBA order, premultiplied).
port_guidance: A native decoder must emit RGBA, premultiply alpha (to match original blending) and flip rows; validate against device captures.

title: 32-bit pointers stored in archive directory
description: JNIDatInit rewrites the u32 at +4 of each 24-byte directory record into an absolute pointer.
port_guidance: Keep the offset and resolve on lookup, or build a separate char* table.

title: Cross-thread shared state without synchronisation
description: UI thread (touch, key, sensor, onPause invalidate) and main-thread OpenFeint callbacks write engine globals read by the GL thread; Java statics HasFocus/AudioInitFlag are non-volatile.
port_guidance: Queue input events to the GL thread (GLSurfaceView.queueEvent or a lock-free ring) and use atomics for flags.

title: JNI misuse that newer runtimes/CheckJNI reject
description: DeleteLocalRef on a global ref (JNIDatInit), GetStringUTFChars without Release (JNIOFOInit), no exception checks, stale local refs.
port_guidance: Fix in the port; run with -Xcheck:jni during validation.

title: softfp float passing
description: ARM32 JNI natives receive float args in core registers/stack (JNIMouseEvent x in r3, y on stack; JNIAccelerometer z on stack); varargs Call*Method pass float as double.
port_guidance: No action for C/C++ prototypes on arm64 (AAPCS64 passes floats in v-registers); only relevant to hand-written glue or emulation.
